email_token_invited_team_check.name: email_token_invited_team_check
email_token_invited_team_check.value: ("email_token"."invited_team_id" IS NULL) = ("email_token"."invited_team_role" IS NULL) AND ("email_token"."invited_team_role" IS NULL OR ("email_token"."purpose" = 'invite' AND "email_token"."invited_team_role" IN ('ADMIN', 'MEMBER', 'VIEWER')))

email_token_verification_shape.name: email_token_verification_shape
email_token_verification_shape.value: purpose NOT IN ('verification','reset') OR ("email_token"."target_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "email_token"."org_id" IS NULL)

email_token_email_change_shape.name: email_token_email_change_shape
email_token_email_change_shape.value: purpose != 'email_change' OR ("email_token"."target_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "email_token"."target_email_normalized" IS NOT NULL AND "email_token"."org_id" IS NULL)

email_token_invite_shape.name: email_token_invite_shape
email_token_invite_shape.value: purpose != 'invite' OR ("email_token"."org_id" IS NOT NULL AND "email_token"."invited_role" IS NOT NULL AND "email_token"."target_email_normalized" IS NOT NULL)

user_kind_refs_check.name: user_kind_refs_check
user_kind_refs_check.value: ("user"."kind" = 'human' AND "user"."project_id" IS NULL AND "user"."external_ref" IS NULL) OR ("user"."kind" = 'external' AND "user"."external_ref" IS NOT NULL AND "user"."project_id" IS NOT NULL)

user_external_ref_length.name: user_external_ref_length
user_external_ref_length.value: "user"."external_ref" IS NULL OR char_length("user"."external_ref") BETWEEN 1 AND 255

team_external_ref_length.name: team_external_ref_length
team_external_ref_length.value: "team"."external_ref" IS NULL OR char_length("team"."external_ref") BETWEEN 1 AND 128

installation_user_scope_shape.name: installation_user_scope_shape
installation_user_scope_shape.value: "installation"."scope" != 'user' OR ("installation"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "installation"."team_id" IS NULL)

installation_team_scope_shape.name: installation_team_scope_shape
installation_team_scope_shape.value: "installation"."scope" != 'team' OR ("installation"."team_id" IS NOT NULL AND "installation"."user_id" IS NULL AND "installation"."project_id" IS NULL)

installation_org_scope_shape.name: installation_org_scope_shape
installation_org_scope_shape.value: "installation"."scope" != 'org' OR ("installation"."team_id" IS NULL AND "installation"."user_id" IS NULL AND "installation"."project_id" IS NULL)

installation_project_scope_shape.name: installation_project_scope_shape
installation_project_scope_shape.value: "installation"."scope" != 'project' OR ("installation"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "installation"."team_id" IS NULL AND "installation"."user_id" IS NULL)

api_key_user_scope_shape.name: api_key_user_scope_shape
api_key_user_scope_shape.value: "api_key"."scope" != 'user' OR ("api_key"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "api_key"."team_id" IS NULL AND "api_key"."project_id" IS NOT NULL)

api_key_org_scope_shape.name: api_key_org_scope_shape
api_key_org_scope_shape.value: "api_key"."scope" != 'org' OR ("api_key"."team_id" IS NULL AND "api_key"."user_id" IS NULL AND "api_key"."project_id" IS NULL)

api_key_kind_check.name: api_key_kind_check
api_key_kind_check.value: ("api_key"."scope" = 'org' AND left("api_key"."key_id", 4) IN ('fyk_', 'plk_')) OR ("api_key"."scope" = 'user' AND left("api_key"."key_id", 4) = 'stk_')

mcp_oauth_state_return_fields_check.name: mcp_oauth_state_return_fields_check
mcp_oauth_state_return_fields_check.value: "mcp_oauth_state"."project_id" IS NOT NULL OR ("mcp_oauth_state"."return_url" IS NULL AND "mcp_oauth_state"."client_state" IS NULL)

mcp_oauth_token_credentials_shape.name: mcp_oauth_token_credentials_shape
mcp_oauth_token_credentials_shape.value: ("mcp_oauth_token"."kind" = 'oauth' AND "mcp_oauth_token"."access_sealed" IS NOT NULL) OR ("mcp_oauth_token"."kind" <> 'oauth' AND "mcp_oauth_token"."credentials_sealed" IS NOT NULL)
